purpose: Machine-first technical distribution shortlist for API directories, agent registries and developer discovery surfaces.
primary_rule: Do not rely on human cold email. Prioritize machine-readable assets, public API documentation and sandbox-callable flows.

channels.name: Own domain machine surfaces
channels.why: Highest control and no platform dependency.

channels.name: GitHub repository
channels.why: Developers, crawlers and agents can inspect versioned docs and JSON assets.
channels.next_action: Add release notes and topics when useful.

channels.name: Postman Public API Network
channels.why: Strong API discovery surface; public workspaces help onboarding and search discovery.
channels.next_action: Use the Marketplace API Directory Pack and the public collection as the source copy. Keep workspace sandbox-only and publish no real API key.

channels.name: RapidAPI Hub
channels.why: API marketplace with provider dashboard, listing metadata, OpenAPI/docs and browser testing.
channels.next_action: Use https://machinesignal.it/marketplace_api_directory_pack_20260606.json and https://machinesignal.it/distribution/rapidapi-listing.json as the listing source. Keep monetized publication blocked.

channels.name: APILayer and curated API marketplaces
channels.why: Potential API buyer traffic, but may be curated and less self-service.
channels.next_action: Submit only sandbox-ready directory copy after owner approval, using the Marketplace API Directory Pack.

channels.name: Smithery
channels.why: Relevant for agent/tool discovery; current asset is a local stdio adapter plus wrapper pack, while a hosted MCP server is not live.
channels.next_action: Use the MCP manifest plus Marketplace API Directory Pack. Decide later whether a hosted MCP endpoint is needed for listing.

channels.name: Glama MCP registry
channels.next_action: Validate whether local stdio adapter listings are accepted or whether hosted MCP is required.

channels.name: AgentNDX
channels.why: Agentic registry focused on MCP, A2A and x402-enabled services.
channels.next_action: Build MCP/A2A or x402-compatible surface first.

channels.name: MCPDrop
channels.why: MCP directory, useful after tool wrapper exists.
channels.next_action: Prepare sandbox-only listing draft after validation.

recommended_next_steps: Publish and polish sandbox-only Postman public workspace copy.
Prepare RapidAPI and API directory listing fields from the Marketplace API Directory Pack.
Keep GitHub and own domain as canonical source of truth.
Validate the public MCP wrapper pack and prepare sandbox-only MCP directory drafts.
